meta.source: VCCP Branding Development V2, Pre-launch social templates, Illustration deck, Campaign planning deck, goodbusinesspays.com

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand dark green from the logo. Logo ink on light and signal grounds, headlines on white, primary button fill on white.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Poster ground. The darkest green, used behind the big headline posters, banners and social tiles.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Brand bright green. The logo mark, headlines on deep or forest, the P frame and rings, brush underlines and scribbles on white. Never as text on white (1.35:1).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary blue, from the logo colourways. Two roles only: the ground for the white logo, and the third chart series (chart-3). White text on sky is 2.7:1, so set any copy on it in forest (4.8:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The highlighted key word and its underline on dark grounds; light ground.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Website page tint (the site theme colour). Alternate section ground under forest text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page or artwork ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section or card ground on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and supporting lines on surface and surface-alt (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, legal lines, source notes on surface and surface-alt (6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: Campaign headlines. Forest on white, signal green on deep and forest.

tokens.name: keyword
tokens.usage: The one highlighted word in a headline. On dark it turns white; on white it stays forest and is marked with signal.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Brush underline or circular scribble around the key word. Decorative: always paired with the word itself.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Button fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Button label on action.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, always underlined, on surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset; 9:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and the logo lockup rule. Decorative only.

tokens.name: search-edge
tokens.usage: 2px inner edge of the SearchField pill, so the white pill holds on white grounds (13:1).

tokens.name: rag-1
tokens.usage: Rating level 1, Excellent (green). Best band of a BenchmarkScale; paid within 30 days; terms of 30 days or less. Label in on-rag-1.

tokens.name: rag-2
tokens.usage: Rating level 2, Good (yellow). Second band of a BenchmarkScale. Label in on-rag-2.

tokens.name: rag-3
tokens.usage: Rating level 3, Fair (amber). Middle band; paid in 31 to 60 days; terms of 31 to 60 days. Label in on-rag-3.

tokens.name: rag-4
tokens.usage: Rating level 4, Poor (red). Fourth band of a BenchmarkScale. Label in on-rag-4.

tokens.name: rag-5
tokens.usage: Rating level 5, Very poor (deep red). Worst band; paid after 60 days; terms over 60 days. Label in on-rag-5.

tokens.name: rag-1-soft
tokens.usage: Pastel of rag-1 for context: inactive benchmark bands, distribution segments, badge chips. Text on it in ink (11:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: rag-2-soft
tokens.usage: Pastel of rag-2 for context. Text in ink (12:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: rag-3-soft
tokens.usage: Pastel of rag-3 for context. Text in ink (11:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: rag-4-soft
tokens.usage: Pastel of rag-4 for context. Text in ink (9.8:1 light, 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: rag-5-soft
tokens.usage: Pastel of rag-5 for context. Text in ink (7.7:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-rag-1
tokens.usage: Text on rag-1 (9.8:1).

tokens.name: on-rag-2
tokens.usage: Text on rag-2 (10.1:1).

tokens.name: on-rag-3
tokens.usage: Text on rag-3 (7.4:1).

tokens.name: on-rag-4
tokens.usage: Text on rag-4 (4.6:1).

tokens.name: on-rag-5
tokens.usage: Text on rag-5 (6.7:1).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled bands and tracks in BenchmarkScale and RangeLine. Decorative: the filled band always carries a label too.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series: the main or 'good' value (paid within 30 days, past periods).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series and the highlighted latest value. On white it always carries chart-edge, because signal on white is only 1.35:1.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series only (for example, over 60 days). Sky's one role outside the white-logo ground. Mid lightness, so it reads apart from forest and signal without relying on hue.

tokens.name: on-chart-1
tokens.usage: Labels on chart-1 (12:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-chart-2
tokens.usage: Labels on chart-2 (11:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-chart-3
tokens.usage: Labels on chart-3 (4.8:1). Never white on sky.

tokens.name: chart-edge
tokens.usage: 2px inner edge on chart-2 shapes and legend keys so signal green holds on white.

styles.name: poster
styles.sample: GOOD BUSINESS IS GETTING BUSINESSES PAID TODAY, NOT TOMORROW.
styles.usage: Hero headlines on posters, social tiles and the site hero. Always uppercase.

styles.name: headline-l
styles.usage: Section heroes and banner stages. Uppercase.

styles.name: page-heading
styles.usage: Plain screen headings in the portal and site (company names, Search results). Uppercase, no key word, no underline.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Waiting for payment holds back the UK's economy
styles.usage: Page and slide titles in sentence case.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We are a social movement for an end to late and slow payments.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Over 50,000 SMEs close a year due to cash flow problems.
styles.usage: Body copy and poster support lines.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Paying businesses sooner will help more of them survive.

styles.name: hashtag
styles.usage: The campaign hashtag at the foot of posters. Uppercase.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “I had 15 more days to wait for a payment and had to borrow from family.”
styles.usage: Business-owner quotes on social cards, 20 words at most.

styles.name: supporter
styles.sample: We’re a proud supporter of Good Business Pays

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related lines; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap from headline to support copy.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and banner padding; P frame and ring stroke width.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Poster margins; gap between sections inside a block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding; ring radius on large artwork.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Posters, banners, social tiles, cards. The brand is square-edged.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The white Sign up here button on banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The site Sign up button and other primary pills.
